source.title: IOGP Life-Saving Rules
source.publisher: International Association of Oil & Gas Producers (IOGP)
source.licence_note: Freely published by IOGP for industry-wide adoption. Rule names, actions and commitments are reproduced here for classification purposes with attribution. The report itself is not redistributed in this repository - download it from the URL above.
source.transcription_note: All 9 rule names and all 9 actions are verbatim, verified programmatically against text extracted from the PDF. 34 of 41 commitments are verbatim; the other 7 are PDF sub-bullets flattened into self-contained lines - e.g. 'I obtain authorisation before: / - deviating from procedures' becomes 'I obtain authorisation before deviating from procedures'. Content is unchanged; only the nesting was removed so each line stands alone for matching.
source.why_this_source: Public, international, and citable. A recommendation traceable to a named rule in a published standard is defensible; invented safety advice is not. OISD standards are the Indian regulatory equivalent but are sold rather than published, so they cannot be redistributed here.
source.signals_note: The `signals` lists are OUR trigger terms for matching narratives to a rule. They are not part of IOGP Report 459 - only `name`, `action` and `commitments` come from the standard. Tune signals freely; never edit the three fields above them.

usage.role: Grounding for hazard classification and control suggestions only.
usage.must_not: These rules do not encode severity. Risk scoring comes from the calibrated SIF model (see docs/RESULTS.md), never from an LLM's reading of these rules.
usage.audience: Output is a draft for an HSE reviewer, not an instruction to a worker.

rules.name: Driving
commitments: I always wear a seatbelt
I do not exceed the speed limit, and reduce my speed for road conditions
I do not use phones or operate devices while driving
I am fit, rested and fully alert while driving
I follow journey management

rules.name: Bypassing Safety Controls
rules.action: Obtain authorisation before overriding or disabling safety controls
commitments: I understand and use safety-critical equipment and procedures which apply to my task
I obtain authorisation before disabling or overriding safety equipment
I obtain authorisation before deviating from procedures
I obtain authorisation before crossing a barrier

rules.name: Confined Space
rules.action: Obtain authorisation before entering a confined space
commitments: I confirm energy sources are isolated
I confirm the atmosphere has been tested and is monitored
I check and use my breathing apparatus when required
I confirm there is an attendant standing by
I confirm a rescue plan is in place
I obtain authorisation to enter

rules.name: Energy Isolation
rules.action: Verify isolation and zero energy before work begins
commitments: I have identified all energy sources
I confirm that hazardous energy sources have been isolated, locked, and tagged
I have checked there is zero energy and tested for residual or stored energy

rules.name: Hot Work
commitments: I identify and control ignition sources
Before starting any hot work I confirm flammable material has been removed or isolated
Before starting any hot work I obtain authorisation
Before starting hot work in a hazardous area I confirm a gas test has been completed
Before starting hot work in a hazardous area I confirm gas will be monitored continually

rules.name: Line of Fire
rules.action: Keep yourself and others out of the line of fire
commitments: I position myself to avoid moving objects
I position myself to avoid vehicles
I position myself to avoid pressure releases
I position myself to avoid dropped objects
I establish and obey barriers and exclusion zones
I take action to secure loose objects and report potential dropped objects

rules.name: Safe Mechanical Lifting
rules.action: Plan lifting operations and control the area
commitments: I confirm that the equipment and load have been inspected and are fit for purpose
I only operate equipment that I am qualified to use
I establish and obey barriers and exclusion zones
I never walk under a suspended load

rules.name: Work Authorisation
rules.action: Work with a valid permit when required
commitments: I have confirmed if a permit is required
I am authorised to perform the work
I understand the permit
I have confirmed that hazards are controlled and it is safe to start
I stop and reassess if conditions change

rules.name: Working at Height
rules.action: Protect yourself against a fall when working at height
commitments: I inspect my fall protection equipment before use
I secure tools and work materials to prevent dropped objects
I tie off 100% to approved anchor points while outside a protected area
